implement.approach: r5 fixes the two r4 adversary breaks on top of r4. (1) Output shape: toOfflineOutput(analysis) in sync.ts = toSyncPayload() minus analysisPermitId, JSON-normalized; runCaptureAnalysis.ts hashes exactly that object into fullOutputSha256 when consuming the allocation, readOfflineScoredReplay() re-derives it for the lost-ack replay identity check, and offlineWallet.presentedOutput() reconstructs it from local_shot and hash-checks it before presenting `output`. The Edge route's parseSyncShot/offlineReceiptOutputRow admit exactly this shape (supabase/functions/api/__wf__/w05_07_offline_output_shape.test.ts: verbatim ShotAnalysis record -> HELD evidence_ambiguous; frozen shape -> result_recorded). (2) Corrupt payload: repository.readScoredShotAnalysis() catches JSON.parse failures and shape/identity mismatches and returns null; presentedOutput() also catches toOfflineOutput() failures -> output:null, so one damaged rating is presented honestly without output and the other receipts in the chunk still settle (adversary A2 kept as regression). (3) Defense in depth on the r4 residual risk: recoverAnalysisJournals() now wraps any caller's permit port in guardOfflinePaidReservations(), pinned by a raw-port recovery regression that fails on the r4 code. r4 fixes the two r3 adversary breaks. (1) Reconnect: guardOfflinePaidReservations(openDb, permitPort) (offlineCapabilities.ts) refuses reserve() when the reservation_key's operation has an offline_receipt (fails closed when the paid-state query itself cannot be read); syncRuntime.ts wraps the permit client it hands to recoverAnalysisJournals() with it, and the sweep no longer counts offline-paid journals as unfinished recovery (healthy cadence). The shared analysis-core runJournal.ts is unchanged from the integration head. (2) Missing grant: offlineWallet.ts builds the complete wire chunk (grant JWS + output reconstructed from local_shot and hash-checked against the receipt) BEFORE inserting the in_flight presentation journal, so a receipt whose grant/output evidence cannot be constructed sends nothing and leaves no in_flight journal; unreadable grant state is an OfflineGrantError, never an empty wallet. Chunking: OFFLINE_RECEIPT_PRESENTATION_MAX_CHARS=1_000_000 bounds each POST; a drain loops over chunks, journals only what it sends, and a lost response leaves exactly one unanswered journal (sent chunk) with the rest still queued.
